verdict.rationale: Bento's docs describe using separate 'Sites' to isolate data, explicitly listing 'Production and testing' as a common reason to create multiple Sites, which lets an AI-native user exercise a test environment without touching production data. However, there is no dedicated sandbox mode, test API keys, or explicit sandbox environment documented beyond this Sites mechanism. missing for 10: dedicated sandbox/test-mode API keys, explicit sandbox environment docs, hands-on confirmation that test Sites fully isolate from production billing/limits.
